Charity Art Sale
• The paintings will be displayed in the Star Gallery and in a nearby .
• The sale of pictures will begin at on Thursday, and there will be refreshments beforehand.
• The money raised will all be used to help the children in New Zealand and other countries.

analyses.content: 录音中提到因为今年画作太多，除了在Star Gallery展示外，还有一些会放在隔壁的咖啡馆（cafe）展出。
你可能会听到“shopping mall”就急着填，但它只是用来修饰Star Gallery的具体位置，并不是题目要求的并列展出地点。
Well, the pictures will be on view all this week, most of them at the Star Gallery in the shopping mall. But we have so many pictures this year that we're also showing some in the cafe next door.
录音明确说明真正的画作售卖（actual sale）是在周四晚上7点半（seven-thirty）正式开始。
你可能会误填成六点半（six-thirty），但录音里说了那是售卖前提供茶点（Refreshments）的时间，是个典型的陷阱。

Now, if you're interested in buying rather than just looking, and we hope a lot of you will be, the actual sale will take place on Thursday evening, with sales starting at seven-thirty. Refreshments will be available before the sale starting at six-thirty.
录音中明确指出，筹集的所有资金将用来帮助新西兰及其他国家的残疾（disabled）儿童。
你可能会因为录音里使用了定语从句“children who are disabled”而没反应过来，导致无法将“disabled”与卷面上的修饰语对应上。

You're probably also interested in what's going to happen to your money once you've handed it over. Well, all proceeds will go to support children who are disabled, both here in New Zealand and also in other countries.

is an artist and a website mainly does

Korean watercolours of New Zealand landscapes

analyses.content: 录音提到这位画家的画作主要描绘了新西兰自然栖息地中的鸟类（birds）。
你可能会被前面关于他女儿背部问题（back problem）的大段背景故事干扰而走神，导致没有抓住后面关于他具体画什么的重点线索。
Don is totally self-taught and says he's passionate about painting. His paintings depict some of our New Zealand birds in their natural habitats.
录音中提到Mr. Chang在来新西兰定居前，曾在台湾举办过13场展览（exhibitions）。
你可能会听到数字“thirteen”就满足了，但题目中“a number of”是对数量的替换词，你必须往后听并填入表示展览的名词“exhibitions”。

One relative newcomer to New Zealand is James Chang, who came here from Taiwan nine years ago at the age of fifty-six. Mr. Chang had thirteen exhibitions in Taiwan before he came to live here in Chr()istchurch, so he's a well-established artist and art has been a lifelong passion for him.
录音提到如果喜欢色彩强烈的抽象（abstract）画，你会很喜欢他的作品。
你可能会听到卷面上的“strong colors”就放松了警惕，从而忽略了紧挨着它的画作类型核心词“abstract”。
His paintings are certainly worth looking at. If you like abstract pictures with strong color schemes, you'll love them.
录音明确说到她除了是一位艺术家，还是一名网站设计师（designer）。
卷面上已经给出了“website”这个词，如果你不仔细看题直接把“website designer”全填上去，就会因为词义重复而冤枉丢分。
Natalie Stevens was born in New Zealand, but has exhibited in China, Australia, and Spain. As well as being an artist, she's a website designer.
录音提到她大部分的画作（Most of her pictures）对应的都是肖像画（portraits）。
你可能会把“portraits”（肖像画）拼错，或者漏听了词尾的复数“s”，这种细节失误在填空题中非常致命。
She believes art should be universal, and her paintings use soft colors and a mixture of media. Most of her pictures are portraits, so watch out, some of them may even be friends of yours.
录音中说她两年前（two years ago）到达新西兰时才开始学英语，这就说明她在新西兰已经住了两年。
你可能会听到后面说她画画超过十年（over ten years）就把“10”填了上去，忽略了那是画画的时间而不是居住新西兰的时间。

And then we have Christine Shin from Korea. Christine only started to learn English two years ago when she arrived in New Zealand, but she's been painting professionally for over ten years, and she sure knows how to communicate strong messages through the universal language of art.
录音中提到她通常根据照片（photographs）来进行创作，这完美对应了题目中的“based on”。
题目中的“based on”在录音中被同义替换成了“works from”，如果你死等原词重现，就会直接跟丢答案。
She usually works from photographs and paints delicate watercolors, which combine traditional Asian influences with New Zealand landscapes, giving a very special view of our local scenery.
